title: Degree-asymmetric pointed pair (Theorem T+) is reconstructible
statement_en: Theorem T+ (degree-asymmetric pointed pair, t3.md section 5): every graph G on at least 3 vertices with u ≠ v such that (i) deg u − deg v is not −[u~v] or 1 − [u~v]; (ii) the ordered pairs (x, y), x ≠ y, with G − x − y ≅ G − u − v that are neither pointed-card equivalent to (u, v) (an isomorphism G − x → G − u mapping y to v) nor to the reverse (y', x') of such a pair are fewer than the pairs pointed-card equivalent to (u, v); (iii) for every pair (x, y) pointed-card equivalent to (u, v), every automorphism of G − x − y preserves G-degrees; is reconstructible.
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => ∃ u v : Fin n, u ≠ v ∧ (G.Adj u v → (G.neighborSet u).ncard + 1 ≠ (G.neighborSet v).ncard ∧ (G.neighborSet u).ncard ≠ (G.neighborSet v).ncard) ∧ (¬ G.Adj u v → (G.neighborSet u).ncard ≠ (G.neighborSet v).ncard ∧ (G.neighborSet u).ncard ≠ (G.neighborSet v).ncard + 1) ∧ {p : Fin n × Fin n | p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ Nonempty (G.induce ({p.1, p.2}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u, v}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) ∧ ¬ (p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = p.2 → (e z).1 = v) ∧ ¬ (p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ ∃ x' y' : Fin n, (x' ≠ y' ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({x'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({x'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = y' → (e z).1 = v) ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = p.2 → (e z).1 = x')}.ncard < {p : Fin n × Fin n | (p.1 ≠ p.2 ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({p.1}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = p.2 → (e z).1 = v)}.ncard ∧ ∀ x y : Fin n, (x ≠ y ∧ ∃ e : G.induce ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({x}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), z.1 = y → (e z).1 = v) → ∀ g : G.induce ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ z : ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), (G.neighborSet (g z).1).ncard = (G.neighborSet z.1).ncard)
